chapter: Joining Earl Hines and the Grand Terrace
title: How Earl Hines heard him and five men joined at once
summary: Hines heard him at the Regal; Wilson, Simeon, Howard, Bishop and Taylor all joined together.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: When did Earl Hines first hear you?
Well, I guess it was when I was with Dave Peyton. At the Regal. He heard me play, and after Dave Peyton left, then Jerome Carrington took over the band.
Yeah, we used to play in the pit and on the stage. So at the time I went with Earl, there was five of us went with Earl at the same time.
Omer Simeon, Darnell Howard, Wallace Bishop on drums, Louis Taylor, trombone, and myself on bass.
